description: Scrape a public page (SSRF-safe fetch) or an HTML string with a CSS selector (CSS3 plus :has, :contains, :nth-child(an+b), attribute operators) or raw XPath: returns each match's text, attributes and optionally outer HTML, or just one attribute (href / src resolved to absolute URLs). Also returns the XPath the selector compiled to. Like querySelectorAll without a browser. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/html-select

attr.description: Return only this attribute per match (href/src made absolute)

name: html_select
title: Html Select
